url: internal: audit of the original GATE-ORF eligibility_rules array

extracted.defect: All four eligibility_rules entries populate verbatim_quote with quotation-marked sentences that the author concedes were never read from the cited primary source. Each is prefixed with a bracketed disclaimer, but the field contract is verbatim text, and the payload is a search-index reconstruction. Any downstream consumer that renders verbatim_quote, or that strips a bracketed prefix, publishes fabricated quotations in a YMYL surface.
extracted.second_defect: eligibility_rules entries carry no confidence field and no null mechanism, unlike the data array. The rule strings are fully populated machine-readable predicates. A consumer therefore reads them as established, even though the data rows for the very same pathways are all confidence=unverified with value=null. The gate is internally inconsistent: it refuses to publish $50 but publishes the predicate set that governs who gets $50.
extracted.highest_risk_entry: medicare_bridge. It asserts indication_restricted_to=obesity_weight_management, counts_toward_part_d_deductible=false and counts_toward_annual_oop_cap=false. None was read from any source. Located secondary coverage frames Bridge eligibility as actively contested ('Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Launches, but Who Actually Qualifies?'), and every CMS, medicare.gov and hhs.gov cross-check failed. A Part D beneficiary relying on these predicates could budget wrongly and be refused at the counter.
extracted.second_highest_risk_entry: copay_card. The rule encodes price_is_floor_not_guarantee=true, which is correct and important, but the gate provides no annual benefit maximum and no expiration date, both of which are standard Lilly savings-card conditions. An unbounded 'as little as $25' is a known counter-surprise pattern.
extracted.required_remedy: Either move verbatim_quote to null and add an explicit confidence field set to unverified on all four entries, or drop the eligibility_rules array from the shipped gate. Do not ship quotation-marked text that was never read.

verbatim_excerpt: Original record, self_pay_journey_program: "[SEARCH-INDEX DERIVED, NOT CONFIRMED VERBATIM FROM PRIMARY - page returned HTTP 403] \"To continue to be eligible for this purchase offer, you must complete your refill purchase of Foundayo within 45 days ...\"" - a quotation placed inside a field whose contract is verbatim primary text.
